description: Geoscape - Perth Roads (Polyline) June 2022 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscape. This dataset is the June 2022 release of Geoscape Roads for a single SA2 area (Perth) with SA2 code (51041). Roads is a digital representation of roads for Australia. This dataset provides an optimised aggregated national view of road geometry and attribution. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscape. Its tags are BUILT ENVIRONMENT AND DESIGN, Building. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is DL-Geoscape. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
